description: Linéaires de stationnement is a dataset listed in Boulogne-Billancourt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Les linéaires de stationnement sur Boulogne-Billancourt et leur type de réglementation. Retrouvez la carte interactive du stationnement sur SoCarto - Le portail cartographique de GPSO. Coverage: Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal files it under Stationnement, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Linéaires de stationnement, Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal shows 630 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boulognebillancourt-seineouest-portal.
